title: Transcribe Video
description: Timestamped transcript with speakers: JSON (segments + words, seconds with 3 decimals) and SRT.
hints: Outputs are in /history under outputs['12']['transcripts']: one .json and one .srt item {filename, subfolder, type: output}.
Word times come only from forced alignment. Words the aligner cannot spell (digits, symbols) have start/end null.
Paste the episode script into SCRIPT so names are spelled right.
Speaker labels are off (every word SPEAKER_00) until the pyannote model is installed; then set 12.diarize = true.
